blocks.text: SM Seaside City Cebu welcomed the holiday season on October 16, 2026 with the launch of its SM Seaside Wonder Express, a Victorian-inspired, train-themed Christmas centerpiece at the Mountain Wing Atrium. The celebration coincided with The Great Seaside 3-Day Sale, running until October 18, bringing together festive attractions and great shopping deals as Cebuanos began their Christmas preparations. Designed around the charm of a railway station, the centerpiece features a Christmas tree and festive details that invite visitors to pause amid their usual mall routines. The railway-inspired setting gives families a place to gather, take photographs, and share in the excitement […]...
